svg.text: TRACE VIEW // One Gateway Responses Call
Log Analytics AppRequests + AppDependencies · OpenTelemetry v2 run 2026-09-27 · facts step, Responses call with an MCP tool

g.text: notebook.workflow story-facts › workflow.run › executor.process facts › invoke_agent ZoDEfendersAgent-1702-backend ›
LiteLLM forwards about 23 ms after the request arrives. In OpenTelemetry v2 the
Neon lookups nest under auth: the postgres spans time the key, user and team
queries, under 6 ms here because LiteLLM had them cached.
Foundry's invoke_agent is a sibling of LiteLLM's server span. Both are
children of the notebook's responses span, because LiteLLM forwards
v2 leaves successful spans unset; the Collector reports them OK. The request
keeps ResultCode 200 and auth and chat report 0, so the Foundry trace view
flags none of them. Neon spans stay unset.
chat gpt-5.6-terra carries the prompt, output, usage and cost that the
Foundry hook fills. batch_write_to_db then flushes spend counters to Neon;
the notebook records its MCP observations once the call returns.
